entry.summary:
We never know what others might be going through. Be kind. Always 🫶

If you’ve been going through a rough patch or feeling a bit off track, remember there are free mental wellbeing support options available right now (links in first comment):

💙 Free face-to-face sessions you can book here: www.wellbeingsupport.nz
💙 Free online therapy courses for mental health and addiction issues: www.justathought.co.nz
💙 More options: Find what works for you on our website: www.healthnz.govt.nz
